description: Adds [data-status="brand"] cascade support: purple brand-colored status tokens that work identically to the standard status values (critical, warning, success, info, urgent) but use the design system's primary brand/accent color. Also defines --sherpa-border-context-brand-default for sherpa-nav-item badge dots. Applied via data-status attribute on any element — descendant components pick up --_status-* tokens automatically through shadow DOM inheritance.

attributes.name: data-status
attributes.description: Set on any ancestor element. Descendants consume --_status-* custom properties. Works identically to data-status="critical|warning|success|info|urgent" but uses the brand (purple) accent color.

cssProperties.name: --_status-surface-subtle
cssProperties.description: Light brand tint background. Light: var(--sherpa-color-brand-100). Dark: var(--sherpa-color-brand-900).

cssProperties.name: --_status-border
cssProperties.description: Brand-colored border. Light: var(--sherpa-color-brand-400). Dark: var(--sherpa-color-brand-700).

cssProperties.name: --_status-text
cssProperties.description: Brand-colored text. Light: var(--sherpa-color-brand-700). Dark: var(--sherpa-color-brand-200).

cssProperties.name: --sherpa-border-context-brand-default
cssProperties.description: Semantic token for sherpa-nav-item badge dot color. Set globally on :root. Light: var(--sherpa-color-brand-400). Dark: var(--sherpa-color-brand-700).

notes: data-status="brand" is NOT generated from Figma Variables — it is hand-maintained in sherpa-brand-status.css because the brand status has no semantic counterparts in the token system yet.
Supports light, dark, and prefers-color-scheme:dark automatically. HC mode falls back to standard contrast values.
The standard status values (critical, warning, success, info, urgent) are defined in sherpa-overrides.css (generated). brand extends that set.
Common use: sherpa-tag data-status="brand", sherpa-message data-status="brand", sherpa-nav-item data-badge-status="brand".

examples.label: Brand message
examples.code: <sherpa-message data-status="brand" data-title="New feature">A brand-new capability is available.</sherpa-message>

examples.label: Brand callout
examples.code: <sherpa-callout data-status="brand">Tip: use the brand status for feature announcements.</sherpa-callout>
